records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Clearwater Analytics!
records.body:
Hi Kai,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

Starter, 8 days left; some chance a technical user self-serves.

draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

Glad the pagination question got answered -- list endpoints use cursor-based pagination, and your ticket on that is now closed. If you're wiring Wrenfield into your own pull, it's worth knowing that projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so that first project shapes what the API returns.

Want me to walk through setting up your first project on a short call this week? I can also answer anything else on the API side while we're there.

Best,
Nadia
